description.value: Banter Room is a lively full-service restaurant and cocktail bar in Vancouver's Yaletown neighbourhood, drawing on West Coast, Italian, Asian, and American influences with locally sourced ingredients. The space features a heated patio suitable for year-round use and can host private events for groups up to 150 guests. Touring cyclists will find a broad menu of shareable plates and mains alongside a serious cocktail program in a vibrant urban setting.
